# Project Development Checklist

## Project Setup
- [ ] Define project type (web application)
- [ ] Choose programming language and frameworks
- [ ] Set up version control (Git)

## Development Tasks
- [ ] Implement user authentication
- [ ] Create database schema for certifications
- [ ] Develop frontend components for certification management
- [ ] Implement backend API for certification tracking
- [ ] Set up notification system for expiration reminders

## Testing
- [ ] Write unit tests for backend
- [ ] Conduct user acceptance testing

## Deployment
- [ ] Choose hosting platform
- [ ] Set up CI/CD pipeline
- [ ] Deploy application

## Documentation
- [ ] Write user manual
- [ ] Document API endpoints

## Maintenance
- [ ] Plan for regular updates and feature enhancements
